name: 25425 · Harpers Ferry, WV
findings: ZIP 25425 (Harpers Ferry) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25425 (Harpers Ferry) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 25425 (Harpers Ferry) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
